UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private creator account profile, subscription tier, credits, and studio preferences for a signed-in FOFO AI user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Creator email address (PII, restricted to owner or admin).

creditsRemaining.description: Remaining generation credits for free tier users.

maxCredits.description: Maximum generation credits for the current cycle.

installedApp.description: Whether the user created or linked their account after installing the app.

cardLast4.description: Last 4 digits of payment card if Visa was used.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profiles keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Strictly isolated to owner (and verified bootstrap admin).
